notes: Primary source: manufacturer's live tech-specs page (vizrt.com), fetched twice with consistent results. An older/legacy NewTek tech-specs PDF (cvp.com/pdf/tricaster-tc1-tech-specs.pdf) shows an earlier hardware revision with different multiviewer (1x DVI + 1x HDMI + 1x DisplayPort), different NIC (2x 1GbE), and 400W/500W(redundant) PSU — the current Vizrt page supersedes this with 2x HDMI 2.1 + 1x DisplayPort 1.4a multiviewer outputs, 10GbE/2.5GbE/1GbE network, and a 500W PSU; this device reflects the current/updated hardware spec. SDI ports are not graded above 3G (spec states "3G/HD/SD-SDI", max SMPTE 424M Level A per the legacy PDF), so grade is sdi-3g. Genlock input connector type is not explicitly stated on the spec page; BNC is the de facto broadcast standard for genlock reference and was inferred (not confirmed) — omitted from the port list since no source explicitly names it as a separate physical BNC jack distinct from SDI. GPI is described as "HD15 GPI connector" — mapped to the closest connector id "vga" (HD15 D-sub) per the port-conversion rule, used for tally/GPI signaling, not video. Power connector type/receptacle (IEC vs other) is not explicitly stated by the manufacturer; internal 500W PSU in a 2RU chassis is standard practice for this class of broadcast gear, so an IEC (C13/C14) inlet was inferred with lower confidence — flagged here as the single biggest caveat. XLR and 1/4" TRS audio ports are specified as "stereo pairs," which have been expanded into individual L/R physical jacks (2 per pair) per the per-port schema. USB counts/types (front vs rear) confirmed on manufacturer page: front 2x USB-A 3.0, rear 2x USB-A 2.0 + 5x USB-A 3.2 Gen2 + 1x USB-C 3.2 Gen2x2. Optional NC1 network expansion modules (for up to 16 simultaneous SDI or 4K quad-link SDI) are not physical ports on the TC1 chassis itself and are excluded.

ports.name: GPI
ports.note: HD15 D-sub GPI/tally connector, not video; closest connector id to the manufacturer-specified 'HD15 GPI connector'

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: Internal 500W PSU in 2RU chassis; manufacturer spec sheet does not explicitly state the AC inlet connector type — IEC C13/C14 inferred as the de facto standard for this equipment class
